def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df = df[df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'])]
    df = df[df['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen'])]
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] > 0]
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return df
